build_enc_t5_classifier: build a T5 encoder-only sequence classification model with a configurable dropout rate and number of labels
run_enc_t5_forward_pass: run a forward pass through the EncT5 classifier with input_ids and attention_mask to get logits
parallelize_enc_t5_model: parallelize the EncT5 model across multiple GPUs using an automatic or custom device map
prune_enc_t5_attention_heads: prune specific attention heads in selected layers of the EncT5 encoder to reduce model size
review_enc_t5_loss_logic: review the EncT5 forward method loss computation supporting regression, single label, and multi label classification
